required_operation_ids: command:python -m physicsguard.cli blueprint bundle-query BUNDLE --module|--element|--case|--impact|--reverse ID --pretty

block_on.condition: a required blueprint projection or its blueprint, review, relation-set, recipe, target-revision, or evidence fingerprint is missing, stale, foreign, ambiguous, or caller-rehashed
any route other than the sole author/full reviewer authors or fully reviews the blueprint
any route-specific blueprint obligation lacks current target-native evidence or is replaced by AI prose or a self-declared pass
the first gap, outside-scope branch, unsupported claim, closure handoff, or bounded claim required by this route is omitted or promoted to pass
bundle presence, bundle load, or an AI answer is treated as current evidence, native execution, high-fidelity reconstruction, or closure
a frozen case pass from the portable bundle is reported as current target-native execution or fresh validation
portable_query_identity_only_terminal is omitted, repaired by scanning, or promoted to resolved content

blueprint_route_contract.claim_boundary: Closure is limited to the exact current affected or full review denominator, achieved depth, first gap, native evidence, outside-scope rows, and safe claim. A portable bundle is frozen interpretation content with observed-at-export execution unlicensed; it cannot author, requalify, refresh, or prove current native execution.

claim_boundary: This guard-model proof blocks only candidate admission when declared target-native obligation evidence is missing or native-failed. It does not independently detect the underlying physical, mapping, topology, workflow, or evidence defect and does not certify upstream truth.
